headline: Godcrofts Tops Change Ledger on War's 236th Day
war_summary: Since the previous wire, Godcrofts still heads the change sheet, with five postings in the latest two-hour watch and twenty-three in six; the earlier dozen-in-two-hour burst has slackened. Fisherman's Row has cooled to three postings in six hours and none in two. Stonecradle is likewise quiet in the two-hour column. But the lull is uneven: Stlican Shelf and the Weathered Expanse, both silent in the earlier report, are posting again—two and four changes respectively in the latest two hours—and both count at least thirty changes over the past day. Linn Mercy has also entered the table, sixteen daily changes and two in the latest two; Mooring County adds two in two hours and eight on the day. It is the 236th day of the campaign, and neither side commands the thirty-four towns required for victory.
